origin.description: Drop leading and trailing space, tab, and newline. There is no whitespace argument.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

origin.details: which is both, left, or right. A unique prefix is accepted.
origin.example:
bp_trimws <- getFromNamespace("trimws", "backports")
print(bp_trimws(c("  a  ", "b  ", "  c")))
print(bp_trimws(c("  a  ", "b  ", "  c"), which = "left"))

translation.description: Drop leading and trailing space, tab, and newline. There is no whitespace argument.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

translation.details: which is both, left, or right. A unique prefix is accepted.
translation.example:
print(trimws(["  a  ", "b  ", "  c"]))
print(trimws(["  a  ", "b  ", "  c"], which="left"))
